title: Shaam ki tareeki
body:
shaam shaam shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ki tareeki mein
noori lashkar lekar chalta hai
karbobala ke gham ka suraj
dhalta hai na bhujta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum bhi pukaro shere khuda ko
tumko bhi maloom to ho
kaise mushkil hal hoti hai
kaise kaam nikalta hai
shaam shaam shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi teri pyaas ki shiddat
sunte hai hum ahle aza
khoon barasta hai aankhon se
dil seene mein jalta hai
shaam shaam shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
us moti ka naam hai gohar
kehti hai tareekhe aza
khatre khoon jab aankh mein behkar
farshe aza mein dhalta hai
shaam shaam shaam...
author: Gohar Jarchvi
